title: My First Coloring Book: Fruits (Part 1)
developmental_focus: Fine-motor coloring practice (whole-hand/early tripod crayon grasp) paired with fruit vocabulary. Thick, bold outlines only -- no fine detail or small enclosed regions, since 2-3 year olds color broadly and outside the lines, not precisely.
safety_notes: One fruit per page, single simple black-line outline on white, no fine internal detail that would frustrate an early crayon grip.
No small enclosed regions (e.g. tiny seeds) that are impossible for a 2-3 year old to color inside of.
Line art only, no pre-filled color -- coloring is the point of this book.
